_moduleContext.name: Password Generator
_moduleContext.author: MAM Team
_moduleContext.description: Generate secure random passwords with configurable complexity and strength assessment
_moduleContext.purpose: Generate secure random passwords with configurable complexity and strength assessment
rules: Default length is 16 characters if not specified
Always include lowercase letters and digits
Strength is based on entropy bits and character diversity
Password must contain at least one character from each enabled set
Cryptographically secure random generation must be used
